question: Do the already persisted RA01 root-response differences show evidence of physical Feddes threshold/regime divergence, or are they compatible with deterministic floating-point aggregation noise at the available output resolution?
findings: Frozen RA01 actual-root-uptake and reconstructed cumulative-root RMSEs are reproduced exactly.
No compared rooted 10-cm mean profile straddles the demand-specific h3 or h4 threshold.
No ACTUAL_RATE difference exceeds the preregistered non-fitted aggregation-roundoff reference.
The largest ACTUAL_RATE difference uses only about 5.36% of that arithmetic reference.
The available evidence therefore supports a numerical-resolution/aggregation-floor interpretation at the persisted output scale.
Node-level Feddes regime identity is not proven because node-level pressure heads and drought-reduction factors were not persisted.
nonclaims: No claim that physical threshold crossings are impossible at node scale.
No reclassification of the frozen RA01 all-metrics qualification rule.
No evidence yet for or against the minimal Layer-ROM dynamic root-feedback approximation.
No crop-model, drought-damage, ET-application, production or performance claim.
next: ROM-ROOT-RA02-D2: preregister a narrow Reference-only diagnostic that emits node-level pressure-head and Feddes drought-reduction regime evidence on the frozen RA01 domain. Keep the Reference blocker and candidate firewall closed until D2 is adjudicated.
